description: Stock market regime, top-5 candidates, movers and the crypto gate from the current session in one payload, including the live awareness read (leaders, money flows, coiled setups, coverage). Live intraday version. Coil Live is a subscription with a 7-day free trial; subscribers connect the Coil Live connector and sign in, and this read returns live data. Agents with an x402 wallet can also pay per call. Without a subscription or an x402 wallet it returns a PaymentRequired object and no data.
name: get_morning_brief_live
